text.description_html:
First Impressions Solid Brass 3-1/4" Decorative Door Stop

These decorative solid brass door bumpers screw onto the baseboard casement or door bottom, to protect the door hardware and wall. Traditional designer styling and hand finished by the master craftsmen at First Impressions International.

Also available: Other Decorative Door Stops by First Impressions.

Specifications for First Impressions FII-SG325 Decorative Door Bumper

  • Length: 3-1/4"
  • Base Diameter: 3/8"
  • Includes Mounting Screw Stud
  • Bumper Tip: White
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finishes: Antique Brass or Polished Brass

Sold Individually.

** This item is being discontinued. Very limited quantities available.
